historicalBaseline.note: R3 evidence is not rewritten by R4 remediation.

entries.title: Oracle wrapper duplicated Vitest command and lost tooling path in nested worktrees
entries.fix: Wrapper now owns the Vitest run verb, accepts an explicit tooling path, creates raw-output directories, and all disposable worktrees are cleaned after evidence persistence.

entries.title: Planner completion could lack an authorized task graph
entries.fix: Planner payloads are revalidated even when recovered from final summary, and the graph must contain coder and reviewer nodes before execution.

entries.title: Current measured free fleet does not sustain every 373-user/373-DAU scenario
entries.impact: Capacity blocks are honest and fail closed; R4.6 scale certification is not claimed.
entries.nextAction: Qualify additional zero-cash routes or obtain an authorized sponsored allocation; never route paid spillover implicitly.

entries.title: OpenRouter daily free counter is not exposed by account endpoints
entries.impact: The documented 1,000/day threshold is account-qualified, but remaining daily capacity must be learned from runtime headers or a 429 reset.
entries.nextAction: Record sanitized response headers and keep capacity reservations conservative.
